  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    BLOCKED
    An installed extension blocked the navigation.
    CANCELLED
    The load was cancelled (by Stop or a new navigation).
    CONNECTION_REFUSED
    The server actively refused (or could not be reached on) the port.
    DNS_FAILURE
    The host name could not be resolved.
    HTTP_CLIENT_ERROR
    The server returned a 4xx status.
    HTTP_SERVER_ERROR
    The server returned a 5xx status.
    MALFORMED_URL
    The address was not a usable URL.
    TIMEOUT
    The navigation exceeded the configured timeout.
    TLS_ERROR
    A TLS/certificate problem prevented a secure connection.
    TOR_CUT
    Private (Tor) mode's kill switch cut the network because tor stopped, so the browser refuses to navigate rather than let a request escape in the clear.
    UNDECODABLE_BODY
    The server compressed the body with a Content-Encoding this browser engine cannot decode, so WebKit discarded it and the direct re-fetch could not recover it either.
    UNKNOWN
    No specific cause could be determined.

    • TOR_CUT

      public static final LoadFailure.Reason TOR_CUT
      Private (Tor) mode's kill switch cut the network because tor stopped, so the browser refuses to navigate rather than let a request escape in the clear. Fails closed: the SOCKS endpoint is dead, so nothing loads until tor is running again (or private mode is turned off).
